[LTSL.4.4] **A schema is named in a test as it is in a rule.** Wherever a
test names a schema — a fact constructed in `initial`, `inputs` or a
`responses` reply ([LTSL.4.1]), and the schema of a `produces` head that
matches one: `emitted`, `published`, `retracted`, `wm has` and `wm count`
([LTSL.4.2], [LTSL.8.2]) — the name is a schema reference of the form a rule
pattern takes, `Name` or `lib.Name` ([LGRA.8.1]), and it resolves the same
way.
